design: ABBA idle/loaded; windowed MCK from raw SOF pairs
findings: MCK does not move with the board own load: idle +13.34/+13.32, loaded +13.27/+13.28, spread 0.07 ppm
the on-die sensor shows no load-dependent shift either - 957.7..960.2 codes in BOTH states

the instrument is far better than its quantisation bound: +/-1 frame over 300 s is 3.33 ppm, but the idle windows counted 300005 and 300006 frames and the four readings span 0.07 ppm, so the edge latch is delivering ~0.1 ppm at five minutes
conclusion: self-heating from full-rate capture with playback does not move MCK at 0.1 ppm nor the die sensor beyond its own noise. MCK cannot serve as a temperature proxy at this power level - the board does not heat itself enough.
not_claimed: that MCK has no temperature coefficient - only that this power step does not reveal one
that the die sensor is broken - its spread is the same in both states, which is what noise looks like
anything about ambient temperature, which was not varied and cannot be here
